main_bar.count is the two-way total of the printed 5+5 / 6+6 mats (section 6b). The 'RB 9 รัดรอบ' edge tie is one bar: stirrup.count 1, no spacing.

Both details print 1.00 from ระดับดินเดิม down to the top of the footing, a 0.25 footing, 0.05 คอนกรีตหยาบ 1:3:5 and 0.05 ทรายหยาบอัดแน่น under it. The column stub C1 is drawn with ties inside the pedestal zone; its spec is on S-06.
Main bars are printed DB12 although the A-01 general notes call for SR24 in footings — the detail is followed (see the notes file).
